leverage.exposure: No leverage. The balance is positive, the only committed money is the standing bid, and even if it clears in full the balance stays comfortably positive. The one leveraged path that exists - borrowing against spending power to reach Lukeba and unwinding with two timed sales before the lock - was priced out and rejected: the upside is modest and a missed sale would mean zero points for the entire matchday. That risk outranks everything else, and Georg executes by hand between briefings.

binding_gap: Still the third attacker. With only two forwards, 5-3-2 is the only shape available and a zero-scorer is forced into the eleven as a third midfielder. Gomis fills exactly that hole - he unlocks 5-2-3, pushes the zero-scorer out, and is worth a large jump on the fielded eleven for one purchase. Nothing else on this board addresses it, which is why the bid stands untouched.

verdict.headline: No action.
verdict.detail: No action. The Tidiam Gomis bid is live and still unopposed, the squad is legal, the balance is positive, and nothing on the board beats what is already committed. The German transfer window shuts at 18:00Z tonight and no Georg squad player appears in any deadline-day exit report, so the deletion risk that would have justified buying a cheap insurance body dies with the window. Sit still until Gomis resolves tomorrow afternoon.

sell.reason: Nothing is sellable. Lokonga remains the right sale on merit - worst points-per-euro in the squad and bleeding value daily - but only once the squad is twelve, which means only after Gomis lands. Bernardo is second in line and carries a knock flag that has neither cleared nor worsened; treat him as doubtful, not ruled out, for Hoffenheim v Dortmund. Widmer is the last body and is not for sale at any price while the squad is eleven.

buy.reason: The standing Gomis bid is the buy and it needs no help: Georg is still the only bidder after five hours, so raising it would burn money in a pay-your-bid auction. Two new listings appeared and both were declined. Castello Lukeba is the painful one - a fit Leipzig defender who has started every match, listed at exactly market value, and the second-best points-per-euro on the board. He is refused only because he is unaffordable: his bare ask is over three million more than the cash, and no combination of legal sales closes the gap in any branch. Keitel is a cheap Augsburg midfielder logged as a watch, not a buy - he now supersedes Krattenmacher as the insurance body because he resolves after Gomis does, so tomorrow's decision can be made with the outcome known rather than guessed.

standing.name: Tidiam Gomis

Ligainsider profile (correct slug is /tidiam-gomis_36962/, NOT _46855 which 404s) marks him FIT and gives 2026/27: 2 appearances, 2 STARTS, 128 minutes (BL 64, DFB-Pokal 64), 0 goals, 3 assists. He STARTED MD1 on 29.08.2026, Leipzig 3:0 Gladbach, and provided TWO assists - 26' for Baku's opener and 49' for Nusa's second - before being taken off at 64' for Nkunku with the game won; rb-fans.de 30.08.2026 confirms the substitution was tactical, not an injury, and that Demichelis started him as a striker. Note also that Ligainsider's generic "voraussichtliche Aufstellung" page for Leipzig lists a different XI (Vandevoordt in goal, Esteve starting) than the one that actually played MD1 (Nicolas in goal, Esteve benched) - that page is a pre-season projection and the actual MD1 lineup outranks it. WHY HE FIXES THE BINDING GAP: Georg carries only TWO attackers, which is why 5-3-2 is the ONLY legal formation and why Amoako (ap 0) is forced into the fielded XI as a third midfielder. Gomis is a THIRD ATTACKER, which unlocks 5-2-3 and 4-3-3 and pushes Amoako out. Best XI now, 5-3-2: Baumann 129; ter Horst 143, Matsima 138, Minjae 110, Bernardo 62, Widmer 29; Nusa 226, Lokonga 44, Amoako 0; Gregoritsch 195, Guirassy 180 = 1256 ap. With Gomis in 5-2-3: 129 + 482 (all five DEF) + 270 (Nusa, Lokonga) + 551 (Gregoritsch, Guirassy, Gomis) = 1432 ap. That is PLUS 176 ap on the fielded eleven for one purchase - by far the largest single-move gain available, because a 0-scorer leaves the XI and a 176-scorer enters it. VALUE: 9.400.000 / ap 176 = 53,4k PER POINT. Georg paid 67,8k/pt for ter Horst this morning and that was the good buy of the day; Ljubicic cleared at 184k/pt, Jatta would be 264k/pt, Aebischer 226k/pt, Deman 430k/pt. Nothing else on this board is close. THE BID, and why it is above the measured cluster: Kickbase board listing, so benchmark the HIGH cluster and never the median (median is +2,98% and is pure manager-ask noise). In the 6-10M mv band the measured high cluster is unusually tight - ter Horst +27,61% (our bid WAS the clearing price), Ljubicic +27,34%, Vagnoman +27,26% - three independent datapoints inside 0,35 of a percentage point. That cluster centre on mv 7.014.962 is 8.951.800. The recommended 9.400.000 is +34,00%, deliberately ~6 points ABOVE that ceiling, for four reasons: (1) ap 176 is the best of every comparable in the band, so more of the 17 rivals want him; (2) 28h of runway is maximum exposure; (3) tonight's 20:00Z tick will reprice him UPWARD (mvt 1, +406.847 in 24h), lifting every rival's willingness to pay before he resolves; (4) every single error in the calibration table is the same error - bidding too low. Maluze was lost this morning by 325.004 on a 5.500.000 recommendation, and Nguefack was lost three times. DO NOT READ THE MALUZE +308,77% RECORD AS LICENCE TO BID +300% HERE - that premium was enormous only because Maluze's mv (1.425.004) had not caught up with his ap (194). Gomis's mv already prices him as a 7M player, so the correctly-priced 6-10M band applies, not the cheap-body band. AFFORDABILITY: cash 16.877.522, so 9.400.000 leaves 7.477.522 and opens NO leveraged position - the negative-balance-scores-zero rule is untouched.
